name: Ad Tags
summary: Extracts advertising, analytics, affiliate and payment account identifiers from a site's markup and from its ads.txt and /.well-known/ files. Desktop only.
description:
For linking sites once the infrastructure pivots have gone cold. A domain is re-registered, a host moves behind a CDN, a certificate is reissued, but a monetisation account is where money arrives and costs identity documents and a payout history to replace. Sites that share a publisher ID, analytics property or payment account often stay linked after their infrastructure no longer is.

**Who sees it:** the target, directly: the selected hosts and wherever they redirect see the analyst's address. With "Follow tag-manager containers" on, Google (www.googletagmanager.com) also receives each container ID with the analyst's address; the target does not see that request.

**Read results with care:**

- **Fan-out.** An identifier already on 15 or more edges (analytics, tag-manager and site-verification IDs) or 40 or more (ad, affiliate, payment and other accounts) is likelier an agency account or a CMS default than a shared operator; the run summary names it.
- **Who put it there.** ads.txt and the /.well-known/ files sit at fixed paths on the host's own document root, so the operator put them there. A script tag in a page may have been injected by a third party.
- **Unknown is not absent.** Scripts are not run, so identifiers injected at runtime are missed, beyond what a Google Tag Manager container holds. Challenge pages, documents cut at 2 MB and unreachable hosts are reported apart from "no identifiers". A bare IP reaches only the server's default virtual host.

**Source:** https://github.com/Vineyard-Intelligence/pluginpack-ad-tags (Apache-2.0)

plugins.name: Ad Tag Extract
plugins.description: Fetches each selected URL, Domain or IP Address and extracts the advertising, analytics, tag-manager, site-verification, affiliate and payment account identifiers in its markup as Tracking ID nodes linked by "carries tracking ID"; PayPal recipient addresses become Email Address nodes linked by "pays". By default also reads the Google Tag Manager containers the page references. Desktop only.

follow_tag_manager.title: Follow tag-manager containers
follow_tag_manager.description: Also fetch each Google Tag Manager container the page references (up to four per page, from googletagmanager.com) and extract the identifiers in it. On by default.

try_www.title: Also try the www / apex host
try_www.description: For a selected Domain, also fetch its www host (or the bare host if the domain already starts with www). No effect on URLs or IP addresses. On by default.

cross_protocol.title: Also try HTTP on 443 and HTTPS on 80
cross_protocol.description: For a selected Domain or IP address, also request http://host:443 and https://host:80, making four requests per host instead of two. No effect on URLs. Off by default.

web_probe.purpose: Fetch the selected sites’ pages, and optionally their Google Tag Manager containers, to extract the account identifiers in them.

plugins.name: Publisher Files Extract
plugins.description: Fetches /ads.txt, /app-ads.txt and the /.well-known/ app-association files from the host of each selected Domain or URL and extracts the identifiers declared in them (ads.txt accounts, Android package names and signing-certificate fingerprints, Apple team IDs, Microsoft Entra application IDs) as Tracking ID nodes linked by "carries tracking ID". From ads.txt it takes the Google publisher ID, OWNERDOMAIN and INVENTORYPARTNERDOMAIN, plus every other DIRECT account when all_ad_systems is on. Desktop only.

all_ad_systems.title: Extract every DIRECT account
all_ad_systems.description: Also extract other ad systems’ DIRECT accounts from ads.txt and app-ads.txt. Google DIRECT publisher IDs, OWNERDOMAIN and INVENTORYPARTNERDOMAIN are extracted either way. Off by default.

web_probe.purpose: Fetch /ads.txt, /app-ads.txt and the /.well-known/ app-association files from the selected hosts.
